Failure: test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py::test_appraise_with_real_image_returns_valid_appraisal -> POST /api/appraise returned 502 {"detail":"AI returned invalid JSON"} instead of 200. This is the live-model rate-limiter fix mentioned in seed_facts (the ghost-username UUID fix passed); the remaining failure is an external AI call returning malformed JSON, unrelated to the 3 changed files this iteration.

bugs.description: Live /api/appraise occasionally returns 502 'AI returned invalid JSON' from the underlying model provider, failing test_appraise_with_real_image_returns_valid_appraisal (backend) and cascading into single-photo-warning-snapshot-behaviour and (once) appraise-save-success-moment-and-why-estimate (browser). Not caused by this iteration's PriceTag.tsx/TagPage.tsx changes — confirmed by identical 502 payload across backend pytest and two independent browser checks, and by the fact these checks worked prior to hitting the live model call.
bugs.evidence: pytest: AssertionError: {"detail":"AI returned invalid JSON"} / 502 == 200. Browser: 'console: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 502 (Bad Gateway)' immediately before Error: appraise call failed: 502 / timeout waiting for appraisal-result.

action_items: Investigate intermittent 502 'AI returned invalid JSON' from the live appraise model provider — appears to be an upstream model/response-parsing reliability issue, not something introduced by this iteration's PriceTag/TagPage fix.

Pre-existing stale check 'sign-out-returns-to-lock-screen' (not in this iteration's required regression lane) still references a removed 'logout-button' testid and the old SarahTest/item-photo-slot login pattern — left untouched this iteration since out of scope, but will keep failing on any future rerun until updated to use more-signout / home-scan-card.
